Fixture licenses and origins

Original synthetic fixtures (CC0-1.0):
single-column.pdf, double-column.pdf, paper-100.pdf, large-320.pdf,
scanned.pdf, corrupt.pdf, external-annotations.pdf, reader.md.
Generated by generate.mjs. They contain original test prose, not published research.
encrypted.pdf derives from single-column.pdf; password: yidu-test.
It was generated with pypdf 6.10.0. See derive.py to reproduce.

Third-party research fixtures (CC BY 4.0):
Thomas Chen and Michael Hott,
"On the emergence of quantum Boltzmann fluctuation dynamics near a Bose-Einstein Condensate",
arXiv:2106.03825v5, 15 February 2023.
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.03825v5
PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.03825v5
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
License verified through the arXiv abstract page's "view license" link.
chen-hott-120.pdf is the complete unmodified 120-page article, including many equations.
chen-hott-100.pdf is an excerpt: pages 1–100 of the original; no changes to page content.
The authors do not endorse this application.
